import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set the style for seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a figure and axis for plotting
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 8))

# Plot a boxplot to show the distribution of Sleep Duration for different BMI Categories
sns.boxplot(x='BMI Category', y='Sleep Duration', data=data, ax=ax, palette="Set2")

# Set labels and title
ax.set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=12)
ax.set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
ax.set_title('Distribution of Sleep Duration Across BMI Categories', fontsize=14)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
